compose_two_gtn_graphs: compose two GTN graphs using gtn.compose to chain transducer operations
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score
find_viterbi_path: find the best scoring path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path
union_multiple_graphs: union multiple GTN graphs into one using gtn.union to combine languages
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove
